rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: The PT's closing statement on the PED 2005, dated 13 October 2005, says that with only 2.8% of the votes left to count Ricardo Berzoini is already elected national president of the PT, with 113,130 votes (51.6%) against 106,224 (48.4%) for Raul Pont.

locator.section: Sub-heading 'Berzoini é eleito presidente do PT' and results table

rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: The same statement says Ricardo Berzoini and the new national leadership are to take up their posts on 22 October at a meeting of the National Directorate.
